source_and_history.required: The actual complete continuous candidate after the failed old API panel; never restore an earlier successful future or reset a learned bank.
source_and_history.scope: Localized versioned access integration in Cognitive. No change to the frozen Native laws, R03 actor/reader, old historical records, RAW, clocks or existing acquired references.

fixed_information_action_contract.codec: Actual Native state identity; no supplied threat label, expected sign, target, operand difference, private fixture or future.

mapping.NULL: invalid selection, not a valid zero or intelligent waiting

outcome_contract.physical_result: The unchanged FI computation is actually executed. Decode the fixed physical early FI record at FI query+4; retain its RAW, signature, zero and NULL distinction. Retain the old late record when available.
outcome_contract.reference_evaluator_only: After the Native function has returned, compute sign(left-right) solely as an external comparison reference. It is never an actor observation, Native answer input, action selector, physical packet value or bank selector.
outcome_contract.generic_failed: actual fixed early Native choice is different from the afterwards computed public sign(left-right), including a NULL where a formed result was required.
outcome_contract.deadline: Actual function must complete before the frozen generic-return deadline; no late request, retrospective credit or clock rewriting.
outcome_contract.requests: Deduplicate all direct current query/efference/actuator/function/return receipts and retain applied, resolved rejected, pending and ambiguous outcomes separately.

prospective_tests.scope: These reserved queries are not used to retune the reader, actor or calendar. Remaining capacity may be used only through an explicit Root plan fixed before those material uses, not an automatic retry until an old example passes.

gates.access_function: All three reserved positive, negative and material-zero results must match their fixed Native physical decoder; NULL is not zero. Preserve every development and failed use, never a favorable last answer alone.
gates.Native_contribution: Record current physical information, actual Native selection, actual actuator receipt/effect and generic consequence. If all successful queries have sensor0 and no admitted pulse, report P0 access/calendar recovery, not newly demonstrated Native protective action.
gates.phase: Compare actual TC/FI/return calendars and contacts. New scheduling and extra material queries are part of this access layer. A success after retiming alone is not acquired regulation or proof of observer neutrality.
gates.historical_interface: A newly integrated outer interface may preserve its public operands and return format while changing latency and material dose. Version that access contract. Do not claim its input count is the old176 or that a new panel is the old929 receipt protocol.
gates.untouched_functions: Historical word/memory literals and the actual sum-to-difference integer binding remain literal; do not supply expected13 as the second operand.
gates.C2C: Internal old C2C dispatch remains a separately tested contract; do not silently wrap or stretch its processing deadline as a side effect of this outer FI access integration.
gates.adoption: This protocol alone authorizes no promotion. Actual gain, matched controls, complete representative conservation, coherent save/reopen, usable commands and exact final source must be checked before any whole-state adoption.

stop: Native function exceeding its prospective finite bound
stopping_and_preservation.preserve: Resolved numeric errors, material zero, NULL and terminal admission failures are scientific outcomes. They remain in the record and do not justify an automatic reset, replay or hidden reader change.

attribution: The host starts the requested FI opportunity, fixes the schedule and interfaces, and evaluates the actual result afterwards. Native chooses the pulse through its inherited physical history. This is a bounded access integration, not a discovered plan, new general agency, learned anatomy or a claim that all old failure causes were erased.
